title: Amethyst weapons and tools
description: Added amethyst weapons and tools to Minecraft
body:
Tired of the monotony of diamond? The Amethyst Tools Mod offers a new, magical choice! We've unlocked the hidden potential of amethyst, transforming it into a powerful and unique set of tools and weapons.

These tools occupy a clever niche in performance: their mining speed surpasses diamond, they swing with swift force, and boast solid, reliable durability. Their true core appeal lies in their unparalleled magical affinity—**the exceptionally high enchantability** of amethyst tools far exceeds conventional materials. This allows you to easily bestow a pickaxe with "Efficiency V" or "Fortune III," or imbue a sword with powerful combat magic, significantly enhancing the rewards and enjoyment of enchanting.

Whether you're seeking to bridge the performance gap between iron and diamond, or simply drawn to the unique aesthetic of deep purple crystals, this toolset perfectly meets your needs. All tools can be crafted using vanilla recipes and repaired with amethyst shards, creating an elegant resource loop.

The Amethyst Tools Mod is thoughtfully designed and balanced within the vanilla ecosystem, aiming to add a touch of efficient and mysterious purple brilliance to your mid-to-late game survival and building experience.

Besides,I originally made armor, but it doesn't render properly, so you can only get it from the creative mode inventory.
(For Minecraft 1.20.1, requires Fabric Loader)
